text: {"chapter":"education/007","summary":"The revision is a coherent, voice-aware half-length abridgment. It keeps the key verbatim lines, the Marx hindsight, the dynamo image, the Civil Law ghost, the Sumner/Apthorp attributions and the final resolution. The main damage is to the Beethoven section (the 'accidental' framing is thinned, and the Wagner coda is cut cleanly), plus some compression of qualifications and irony in the opening, the language story and the Gymnasium indictment.","verdict":"editorial_review","coverage":[{"axis":"causality_and_setup","status":"findings","assessment":"The Civil Law and the Common Law reasoning survive. The Gymnasium step loses the stated motive of ridding him of the university, and the Beethoven passage loses part of its setup."},{"axis":"referents_and_scene","status":"no_material_issue","assessment":"Entrances, speakers and places stay clear. The beer-hall is established before the symphony, and Sumner and Apthorp keep their remarks."},{"axis":"dialogue","status":"no_material_issue","assessment":"Sumner's cabman boast and Apthorp's schooling suggestion keep correct attribution. Sumner's quotation survives verbatim, as does Adams's 'loathed Beethoven' reply."},{"axis":"qualification_and_facts","status":"findings","assessment":"Some hedged or ironic qualifiers are lost. The Gymnasium paragraph loses 'a bit of education which served him some purpose'. The German-reasoning claim and the 'German society, if it existed' qualification are also cut."},{"axis":"viewpoint_and_revelation","status":"no_material_issue","assessment":"Marx and the fifty-years-later London remain old-narrator hindsight. The boy still does not know of Marx."},{"axis":"voice_and_rhythm","status":"findings","assessment":"The main epigrams survive. Some semicolon piling, the 'single step to a higher life' irony and the comic bathos of the Gymnasium are thinned."},{"axis":"interpretive_structure","status":"findings","assessment":"The accidental-education theme is partly weakened in the Beethoven passage. It also loses the point that no other sense awoke, since the Kant/Hegel and Goethe lines are cut."},{"axis":"planned_dependencies","status":"findings","assessment":"Five of six dependencies are intact. The school's shock to him loses its deflating setup.","evidence":[{"document":"education/007/source","paragraph":10,"quote":"At least it ridded him of the university and the Civil Law"},{"document":"education/007/revision","paragraph":11,"quote":"The idea suited Adams's desperate frame of mind."}],"counterevidence":"The sentence 'as though he had not always avoided high schools' keeps the comic reluctance.","plan_relation":"optional tradeoff","minimal_repair":"Restore 'At least it ridded him of the university and the Civil Law.'","confidence":"medium"},{"id":"F3","priority":"tradeoff","axis":"voice_and_rhythm","title":"Opening's ironic parental portrait and tourist-student comedy compressed","origin":"first_draft","claim":"The critic's reply about Europe's help, 'timid parents', and 'Whether the boy deserved such indulgence' are cut. The Sumner rupture is not foreshadowed.","evidence":[{"document":"education/007/revision","paragraph":10,"quote":"he was pleased to find a young worshipper in the remote Prussian wilderness"},{"document":"education/004/production","paragraph":12,"quote":"The boy worshipped him"}]},{"index":5,"status":"intact","assessment":"The final resolution against Berlin is firm, and the later Berlin memories in 029 pay it off.","evidence":[{"document":"education/007/revision","paragraph":18,"quote":"it should not be again in Berlin."},{"document":"education/029/production","paragraph":9,"quote":"forty years of varied emotions had not deadened his memories of that city"}]}],"strengths":["The Marx hindsight and the London fifty-years-later passage remain marked as old-narrator knowledge.","Sumner's cabman boast and Apthorp's schooling suggestion stay correctly attributed, with the quotation intact.","The Civil Law reasoning (it needs prior Common Law) is complete and keeps the thirteenth-century lecture-system joke.","The final tramp-to-resolution sequence keeps its rhythm and its epigrammatic close."]}
